title: Christmas Gift Ideas: Indian Outfits for Her (2026 Guide)
excerpt: Indian outfit gift ideas for Christmas at every budget, from $27 tunic tops to $52 kurta sets, plus how to get the size right for a surprise.
body:
The best Indian outfit gifts for her this Christmas are a hand block print tunic top for an easy surprise, an embroidered kurti or co-ord set for a middle budget, and a full kurta set with dupatta when you want something truly special. Prices run from $25 to $52, and for kurta sets you can choose a ready size or share her measurements for a free custom fit.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Every piece is stitched in our own Jaipur unit, with block prints printed by hand by karigars.*

**Quick answer**

- Under $20: a hand block print cotton tunic top
- Around $25: an embroidered kurti with side tie-up
- Around $35: a cotton co-ord set with palazzos
- Around $50: a kurta set with pants and dupatta
- Not sure of her size? A tunic top is the most forgiving surprise

## What is a good Indian outfit gift for Christmas?

A good gift is something she will actually wear, not just admire. Think about her life: does she work in an office, love brunches, go to lots of family functions, or live in comfortable clothes at home? Match the gift to the moments she dresses for most.

For someone who loves pretty, feminine pieces, the [peach pink embroidered cotton kurta set with cutwork organza dupatta](/products/peach-pink-embroidered-cotton-flex-kurta-pant-organza-dupatta-set/) is a lovely full-outfit gift. It works for a Christmas lunch, a day wedding or a baby shower, so she will reach for it again and again.

## What can I gift at each budget?

| Budget (USD) | Gift | Good for | Why she will like it |
|---|---|---|---|
| $27 | Hand block print cotton tunic top | Friends, colleagues, sisters | Easy with jeans, forgiving fit |
| $25 | Embroidered kurti with side tie-up | Someone who loves colour | Festive but everyday |
| $35–36 | Cotton co-ord set | Someone with a modern style | A full look in one piece |
| $48–52 | Kurta set with pants and dupatta | Mum, wife, mother-in-law | Ready for festivals and functions |
| $52 | Anarkali suit set | Someone with a wedding coming up | A statement outfit |

## Which tunic top makes a good small gift?

Tunic tops are the easiest gift to get right. They sit at the hip, go with jeans or trousers, and do not need an exact fit. The [sky blue hand block print cotton tunic top](/products/sky-blue-hand-block-print-cotton-tunic-top/) is soft, breathable and calm in colour, so it suits most tastes.

You could also pick a coral, aqua or olive tunic to match her favourite colours. Browse all our [cotton tunic tops](/cotton-tunic-tops-short-kurtis-for-jeans/) if you want to compare shades.

## What about a co-ord set or kurta set?

A co-ord set feels modern and is a great gift for someone who prefers Indo-western style. The [white and blue floral cotton halter peplum top with palazzo co-ord](/products/white-blue-floral-cotton-halter-peplum-top-with-palazzo-co-ord-set/) is fresh and playful, perfect for a holiday or summer in Australia or the UAE.

For a mother, wife or mother-in-law, a kurta set is the gift that says you thought about it. The [mint green hand block print cotton kurta set with hand work yoke](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) is printed by hand and finished with yoke detailing, so it feels special while staying easy to wear.

## How do I get the size right for a surprise?

This is the part most people worry about. Here are three ways to handle it.

### Ask someone close to her

A sister, best friend or daughter may know her measurements, or can find out without spoiling the surprise.

### Choose a ready size

If you know her usual size, a ready size ships in 2–4 working days.

### Share her measurements for a free custom fit

If you can get her bust, waist, hip and height, we will stitch to measure at no extra cost. Our guide on [how to measure for a custom kurta set](/blog/how-to-measure-yourself-for-a-custom-kurta-set/) explains each step.

If her measurements turn out to be a little off, our fit promise covers one free alteration, with up to $10 of local tailor credit. If we stitched it wrong, we remake it for free.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Hand block printing leaves tiny, natural variations in each print, a little shift in colour or line. These are not faults. They are the sign of a karigar's hand, and many people find that is exactly what makes the piece feel like a real gift.

## When should I order a Christmas gift?

Made-to-measure takes 5–7 working days to make, plus about 5–10 business days for delivery. For 25 December, order at least 3–4 weeks before. Shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia is free and tracked, with duties and taxes included, so she will have nothing to pay at the door.

For gifting tips from the festive season, see our [kurta set gift guide](/blog/kurta-set-as-a-diwali-gift-guide/).

## Our pick for you

For a sweet, small gift, the sky blue tunic top. For a modern friend, the floral co-ord set. For your mum or mother-in-law, the mint green or peach pink kurta set. A thoughtful touch: include a care card so she knows to wash block print cotton gently in cold water.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is a good Indian clothing gift for my wife?**
A kurta set with a dupatta is a lovely, wearable gift. Choose a colour she loves and share her measurements for a free custom fit.

**Can I buy an Indian outfit as a gift without knowing her size?**
Yes. A tunic top is the most forgiving choice. For kurta sets, choose her usual ready size or ask someone close to her for measurements.

**How much should I spend on an Indian outfit gift?**
Our pieces range from $27 for a tunic top to $52 for a kurta set or Anarkali, so you can find something special at most budgets.

**How do I wash a hand block print cotton gift?**
Wash it separately in cold water with a mild detergent for the first few washes, and dry it in the shade to keep the colours fresh.
